sources.title: Search for local land charges on land and property
sources.verified_claim: The national service searches local land charges that may restrict land use; not all authority data has migrated yet and users must check service coverage.

sources.title: HM Land Registry: Local Land Charges Programme
sources.verified_claim: HMLR is migrating local registers to a national service; the programme notes that a property can remain subject to a charge regardless of whether that charge has been registered and that other enquiries may still be needed.

sources.title: HM Land Registry: local land charges search results
sources.verified_claim: HMLR publishes authority-specific explanations for migrated search results and updates them as councils join the service; migration date and result format therefore remain material.

sources.title: Local land charges migration
sources.verified_claim: HMLR provides live-service and migration guidance for local authorities; migration is phased and cannot be assumed complete everywhere.

sources.title: Local land charges search
sources.verified_claim: Enfield states its LLC1 register has moved to the national digital register while the council continues CON29 work; a recognised address or outlined site plan is required for searches.

sources.title: Local authority searches - Search for local land charges
sources.verified_claim: Havering states it is in the initial stages of the HMLR migration project and continues local LLC1/CON29 searches; ownership or fence-boundary questions are explicitly directed to HM Land Registry.

sources.title: Carry out a local land charge search
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth states its LLC register has migrated to HM Land Registry while Lambeth continues to provide CON29 replies; LLC and CON29 are therefore separate due-diligence components.

sources.title: Local Land Charges - HM Land Registry customer help
sources.verified_claim: HMLR directs specific missing-charge, correction and clarification issues to the relevant local authority and distinguishes those from general LLC service enquiries.
